meta.title: DSH Danbooru tools
meta.description: DSH bundle made by an AI agent (14 tools, designed, implemented and verified by AI) — read-only, image-only Danbooru tools (video posts are filtered out automatically). Search: posts and tags (year, rating, Hot/score order), tag details with wiki excerpts, related tags. Artist discovery: (1) whole-year total-favorites ranking with a body-shape tag gate plus optional skin (color/texture) and overall color-tone references; (2) Hot / favorite-growth / fallback weighted sampling; (3) similar artists (tag profile + facial-expression profile re-ranked by expression-tag cosine; furry and 3D themes downweighted); (4) image-to-artist search (the agent groups image tags; layered weights person → expression → technique → lineart → clothing material effect → color → lighting; identity/decorative tags are dropped, single-dimension evidence is demoted, near-duplicate variants are clustered by parent_id/md5); (5) style-first whole-look matching (style×style / style×body / style×genre scans + style-tag verification; identity/appearance tags rejected and body-detail treatment used as secondary evidence; small-artist co-occurrence discovery, seed_artists reinstatement, persistent rejection memory so rejected artists are not re-suggested automatically; optional character mode); (6) multi-scheme consensus (intersection of several shortlists to drop single-scheme flukes); (7) body-part specialist ranking. Examples prefer posts that carry the requested tags and show the face; allow_no_face=true permits back views, silhouettes and other face-hidden compositions. Saved credentials lift the tag limit. R18 is included by default; pass rating=g for general only. Note: this is a DSH bundle, not a standalone program.
